# KOV Career Agency

> KOV Career Agency is an independent, founder-led career representation and talent advisory service for senior and experienced professionals. It works for the candidate, never for corporate HR. Services: Private Career Representation (primary) and seven separate Individual Career Services. Works remotely with professionals in global markets. Founder: Daniel Ade. Contact: daniel@kovcareeragency.org.

Scope is agreed before work begins. Fees are agreed individually and confirmed in writing; enquiries are free. KOV does not promise employment, interview, hiring or timeline outcomes. Confidentiality is the default.

## Individual Career Services
- Resume and CV Writing & Optimization: Organises and sharpens a resume or CV so recruiters can quickly understand the professional's skills and experience.
- LinkedIn Profile Optimization: Aligns the headline, About section, experience and skills into one consistent professional story.
- Career Documents: Develops supporting materials such as cover letters, professional biographies, role-specific summaries and outreach messages.
- Career Portfolio Development: Turns selected projects, case studies, work samples and publications into a portfolio that shows the professional's contribution.
- Personal Career Website: Builds an online professional home for a biography, experience, selected work and contact details.
- Career Positioning & Optimization: Identifies suitable roles and markets, finds gaps in how a background is presented, and sets out a practical plan.
- Career Coaching: Structured guidance on career direction, transitions, interviews, negotiation and next-step decisions.
